name: Embertone Joshua Bell Violin
help: Solo violin, one line (pick it with Voice). For the author's control preset: dynamics on velocity (kept 18-118 so it never slides), CC1 vibrato, Sustain C1 / Staccato D#1 / Pizzicato F#1 / Tremolo C#1 / Harmonic G1. Natural feel: real vibrato on held notes (CC1 set before each note), portamento on wide slow intervals, rebows on long notes, CC64 on fast runs. For double stops turn on Intuition → Multi-Stop Attacks. Optional, with keys added to your control preset: spiccato, attack styles, swells, dramatic releases.
